purpose: Add a casual, assured tone to a statement.
keywords: Plain clause + さ; phrase + さ as conversational filler
Even if you fail, you can just start again.
I can do that much myself.
You know, I am moving tomorrow.
formation: Plain clause + さ; phrase + さ as conversational filler
restrictions: Often familiar or rough; tone varies with region and speaker.
mistake: Avoid this plain ending in formal requests or respectful announcements.
